head: WhatsApp groups get four new catch-up features
dek: WhatsApp is rolling out four features for group chats: pins that never expire, sharing recent messages with new members, a status only one group sees, and a filter for mentions and replies.
details: Pinned messages used to expire after 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days. To show a new member what they missed, tap their name in the chat. A group status disappears after 24 hours like any other status. The new filter lists unread group chats where someone mentioned you or replied to you, including @everyone mentions from admins.
where: Android and iPhone, reaching more accounts over the coming weeks
means: In busy groups you can find the messages meant for you faster, and new members don't have to ask what they missed.
todo: Update WhatsApp from your app store. If you don't see the features yet, they should reach your account over the coming weeks.
